newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keisei Electric slumps on Oriental Land debut.
newsitem.headline: Keisei Electric slumps on Oriental Land debut.

text.p: Keisei Electric Railway Co Ltd's shares slumped in Wednesday trade, depressed by the debut of Oriental Land Co Ltd which was not as heated as investors had hoped, brokers said.
As of 0448 GMT, Keisei's shares were 73 yen lower at 859 yen, in a trade of 7.035 million, the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange.
Keisei Electric is a large shareholder in Oriental Land, the operator of Tokyo Disneyland.
Unlike Nippon Broadcasting's shares which saw an avalanche of bids on its debut, bidders were finding sellers of shares in Oriental Land fairly quickly.

"Keisei shares rose in anticipation of the listing, but now that Oriental Land has gone public and the share price is out, investors feel there is not much reason to hold on to Keisei shares," one foreign broker said.
